threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a ‘cold pint’ means anything other than warm lager that costs a fiver in a pub full of hipsters.
Last night on the 59 bus, a guy serenaded a couple with 'Wonderwall' while another was having a heated debate about whether pineapple belongs on pizza.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting at Hermannplatz, I saw a group of kids playing in the fountain, while a man smoked a cigarette, totally unfazed by the chaos. That’s when it hit me—this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a massive outdoor flea market where you can buy vintage vinyl, freshly grilled sausages, and hand-carved wooden toys, all while listening to a live jazz band.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they casually mention how the BART's delays are just another Tuesday. Outsiders act surprised—it’s all part of the commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a bus driver calmly handle a fight between two riders while still keeping time on his route. That’s the real transit artistry of Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all bars are open late; meanwhile, many locals have their last caña by 11 PM, preferring the quiet of home.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of their food at local tapas bars and ask if the sangria is made with red or white wine.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the train' like the rest of us. That and not knowing where the nearest pub is.
Last night on the 59, a passenger serenaded us all with a full rendition of 'Wonderwall'. A proper Brixton moment, everyone just vibed along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw kids racing their scooters past a street artist painting a mural, while an old lady played the accordion on the corner. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see a bus stop that doubles as an art installation, with graffiti that changes weekly. Makes waiting for the M10 much more interesting!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they know the exact time to avoid the 49 bus after 6 PM, or when they instinctively duck into a taco spot during BART delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a busker playing 'California Dreamin''—it was raining inside and outside. Perfect SF moment, right in the heart of the chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all 'patatas bravas' are the same, but the secret is in the sauce. You can tell a local by what they dip.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they still patiently wait for the light to change at crosswalks, even when there's no cars in sight.
